payload.tension: The passage states the scene includes prophecies, warfare, and faith. It also includes conscience, shipwreck, and named people. It also includes delivery to Satan and instruction not to blaspheme. Together, these details close the charge. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Satan's story.
